customer.business: Abora Automation (sets up a missed-call SMS/WhatsApp reply and enquiry summaries for trade businesses)
customer.target: Owners of small trade businesses in Germany (plumbing/heating, electrical, roofing, painting, carpentry, landscaping) who are on site all day and miss calls
customer.notes: ALL GUESSES by the founders' assistant, not data: shares, incomes and behaviours are estimates. Only real input so far: founders say most enquiries come by phone; one owner called was close to retirement and not interested.

segments.name: Established business, 6-15 employees, partner or office help does the phone

behaviours.name: Overbooked
behaviours.how: Has more work than time; a missed call barely hurts because the order book is full for months.

behaviours.name: Growth-minded younger owner
behaviours.how: Took over or founded the business recently, uses WhatsApp and Google, wants more and better jobs.

behaviours.name: Tech sceptic
behaviours.how: Avoids new software, distrusts anything with 'KI', buys only what a colleague recommends.

behaviours.name: Penny pincher
behaviours.how: Counts every monthly fee, cancels subscriptions he does not use.

behaviours.name: Wife/partner does the office
behaviours.how: A family member answers the phone part-time and does quotes in the evening.

behaviours.name: Near retirement
behaviours.how: Plans to stop or hand over within a few years and avoids new commitments.

behaviours.name: Emergency trade
behaviours.how: Many urgent calls (burst pipe, heating failure); a slow reply loses the job to the next number on Google.

pitch:
Abora Automation from Viernheim, for trade businesses (Handwerksbetriebe).
Free first: a 14-day "missed call check". We count how many callers rang you while you were busy and never called again. You see your own numbers before you pay anything.
Then "Kein Anruf verloren": you keep your own number; calls you can't take are forwarded. Callers on a mobile get an SMS or WhatsApp within seconds ("We're on a job and will call you back today. Reply with a text, photo or voice note saying what it's about"); landline callers hear a short recorded greeting in your name and can leave a message. Every request reaches your phone as a short summary, emergencies first, plus an evening overview.
Fully booked? Switch on "ausgebucht" mode: callers are told politely you have no free dates right now; only emergencies and your regular customers come through.
No setup fee. First 30 days free, then 99 € per month, cancellable monthly, no VAT. If you cancel, we remove the forwarding the same day.
A new company with two founders and no customers yet; there is a demo you can call yourself.
